source.paper: O'Brien et al. 2026, SKYSURF-11: A New Zodiacal Light Model Optimized for Optical Wavelengths, ApJ 1000, 6; arXiv:2510.18231v2 (28 Apr 2026)
source.equation_locator: arXiv:2510.18231v2 HTML rendering (https://arxiv.org/html/2510.18231v2): Eq. 2 (scattering-only line-of-sight integral), Eq. 4 (three Henyey-Greenstein terms), Eq. 13 (normalisation of the phase function to 1 over the sphere), Eqs. 15-21 (albedo and phase parameters linear in wavelength); App. B (validity 0.3-1.6 um, Sun angle above 80 deg)
source.equation_locator_note: the v2 PDF typesetting numbers the same relations one lower (normalisation Eq. 12, coefficients Eqs. 14-20); this file follows the HTML numbering the HMI lane's decision cites
source.implementation_contract: the paper's printed (rounded) coefficients; the authors' public repository carries no licence, no code is taken from it, and its unrounded numbers are not part of this contract
source.geometry: Kelsall et al. 1998, ApJ 508, 44, Table 1 and Eqs. 6, 8, 9, in the forms of the DIRBE model code (dust bands with 1 + (zeta/delta_zeta)^p / v; ring and trailing feature without the factor 1/2; Planck 2013 XIV Sect. 4.1); the full-precision values are identical in zodipy 1.1.5 component_params.DIRBE and in the ZodiSURF public code's aend_og_wlabels.json

scattering.phase_function: Phi(Theta) = sum_i w_i (1 - g_i^2) / (1 + g_i^2 - 2 g_i cos Theta)^(3/2), per steradian, no 1/(4 pi) factor (Eq. 4); Theta = 0 is forward scattering; Eq. 13 normalises it to 1 over the sphere, i.e. 4 pi sum_i w_i = 1, which the paper's fit holds within 0.003 (Sect. 6.2); used as published, not renormalised

geometry.frame: heliocentric mean ecliptic and equinox of J2000, astronomical units

line_of_sight.quadrature: Gauss-Legendre per component over the part of the ray inside its shell
line_of_sight.note: the public code integrates every component on one Simpson grid of 0.025 AU steps to the 5.2 AU sphere; zodipy uses 50-point Gauss-Legendre per component over the same shells as here

domain.wavelength_rule: a solar spectrum with weight outside 0.3-1.6 um is refused when the provider is built (ZL_ZODISURF_WAVELENGTH_OUTSIDE_DOMAIN); a kernel requested outside it is refused, never clamped
domain.sun_angle_rule: a node whose solar elongation is 80 deg or less is REFUSED (ZL_ZODISURF_SUN_ANGLE_OUTSIDE_DOMAIN, NaN) and nothing is computed there; the supported provider takes no argument that moves the limit; never spliced with the ETC table; the older DIRBE 64-deg coverage does not validate the optical phase function at 64-80 deg

excluded.isotropic_terms: no isotropic component: neither the paper's residual diffuse light (0.013 MJy/sr, Sect. 6.4; wavelength-dependent HST Sky - DGL - ZodiSURF of unresolved origin) nor its spherical toy component (Sect. 7.3, fitted at 1.25 um) is a calibrated 400-1000 nm camera component
excluded.anchoring: no V anchor, no Leinert recolouring, no TESS-fitted scale, no ETC-shape hybrid

kelsall_1p25um_reference_mode.use: test oracle for the shared geometry only (Kelsall's own scattering at 1.25 um); never a sky model here
kelsall_1p25um_reference_mode.source: Kelsall et al. 1998 Table 2 at 1.25 um as carried by zodipy 1.1.5 source_params (ALBEDO_DIRBE, C1_DIRBE, C2_DIRBE, C3_DIRBE, SOLAR_IRRADIANCE_DIRBE)
